full_judgment:
S.K. Sinha J: This petition for leave to appeal is directed from the judgment and order dated 12th August, 2010 of a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 18889 of 2010. 

 3. The respondent was arrested by the police on 3rd February, 2010 and then he moved an application for bail before the Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Dhaka. The learned Sessions Judge by his order dated 16th June, 2010 rejected the prayer for bail in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.4986 of 2010. Thereafter, the accused respondent moved High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.18889 of 2010. A Division of the High Court Division after hearing made the rule absolute and enlarged him on bail. Being aggrieved by the said order the state filed this civil petition for leave to appeal.
